lines.t: A star in the eastern sky
Shines brightly in the night
To reveal our Lord's birth
This great day brings us light
The fulfillment has come
A virgin gave birth to God's Son
So that He, the bread of life
Will save our souls
A complete transformation
To unite us as one
We who are His sheep will bring glory to God's Son
A remnant, few of His flock, the chosen ones
By the prophet of the Lord, His will is done
A new found joy one can’t explain but
Only those who know His name
Will shout the trumpet call of God
They'll raise His staff, the Holy rod
(Verse 3)
To announce the coming King
In one accord His saints will sing
The mighty song of the Lamb begins
As His Holy choir shouts—
The mighty song, the song of the Lamb begins
As His Holy choir shouts—
A complete transformation
To unite us as one
We who are His will bring glory to God's Son
A remnant, few of His flock, the chosen ones
By the prophet of the Lord, His will is done
In one accord His saints will sing
The mighty song, the song of the Lamb begins
As His Holy choir shouts—
YAHUSHUA REIGNS!
